scheme_name: Financial Assistance for Working Women Workers or Wives of Male Workers for Maternity- Haryana Labour Welfare Board
other_conditions: Employed in an industrial or commercial establishment in Haryana
Registered with the Haryana Labour Welfare Board
Service period of the workers is fixed for one year
Application must be made within 1 year from the date of birth of the child
Benefit provided for delivery of up to two children (three girls or two boys)
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹10,000 is provided to women workers and wives of male workers for the delivery of up to two children (three girls or two boys).
